packs.title: Stages, Sports & Open Space
packs.promise: Explore Anaheim's resort details, gathering places and open landscapes.

q.s: Find how a promenade changes texture without changing streets.
st: Enter Downtown Disney through its current public pedestrian route.
Find three different surface or facade materials visible from the open promenade.
List the materials and choose the one that most changes the mood of the walk.

q.s: Sketch the shape that welcomes a crowd.
st: Choose a public view of the convention center approach without entering an event queue.
Notice one broad architectural line and one smaller human-scale feature.
Sketch how those two shapes make room for arriving people.

q.s: Compare a restored habitat with its neighboring city.
st: Enter from an open Anaheim Coves access point and choose a comfortable trail segment.
Find one planted habitat feature and one built city feature visible from the trail.
Sketch or describe how the two meet without leaving the path.

packs.title: Center Street & Packing District
packs.promise: Follow Anaheim's older civic buildings into its reused citrus district.

q.s: Find three scales of a civic park.
st: Choose an open walking path through Pearson Park.
Find one small detail, one group-sized space and one large gathering feature.
List all three and note how their sizes change what people can do there.

q.s: Sketch the public face of an old library.
st: View the Historic Carnegie Building from an open public sidewalk.
Find two entrance or window details that make the building read as a civic place.
Sketch a simplified front door using those two details.

q.s: Turn an open park into a simple design.
st: Walk an open public path in Farmers Park.
Notice one repeated planting or paving shape without entering a bed.
Draw a four-part pattern inspired by that shape and name its source.
